star_recon_menu_desc: Settings for various aspects of the mod. More detailed explanations in mod folder.
recon_enemy_set_desc: Which enemies to use for recon (and reinforce/sabotage if enabled) for the relevant faction. Most options will vary across the heist based on current diff value (see The Long Guide for details).
recon_no_lights_exp: Avoid light enemies without health scaling (e.g. basic cops) where possible. Only affects Standard and Fixed enemy sets (excepting russia for the latter).
recon_bronco_guy_desc: Where appropriate, adds a small chance for a bronco (or other pistol) wielding cop to spawn alone as recon, reinforce or sabotage.
recon_assault_condition_desc: Under what condition will recon enemies spawn during an assault
recon_sneaky_recon_desc: If enabled, certain types of recon such as hostage rescue team can enter through cloaker spawn locations like vents.
recon_bag_fix_desc: Allow enemies to carry more types of bags. Notably weapons and equipment such as the thermal drill.
recon_gangster_no_flee_desc: Gangsters and other non-police enemies don't flee from the map if assigned to recon, unless they can't find an objective.
recon_allow_reinforce_desc: If enabled, restores the reinforce task as well.
